info.title: git-unpack - Unpack Git pack files and refs to loose format
info.description: CLI tool to unpack Git pack files to loose objects

options.name: --delete
options.description: Delete pack files and packed-refs after unpacking

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show each object/ref as it's unpacked

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help message
UNPACKS:
- Pack files (.git/objects/pack/*.pack) -> loose objects
- Packed refs (.git/packed-refs) -> individual ref files

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description:
Path to .git directory or repository root
(defaults to current directory)
